description: Declare WHAT KIND of thing delivers a capability — never whether it was delivered, which stays computed. `artifact` (the default): a file realizes it, and delivery needs BOTH the file and a passing check. `model`: the deliverable IS the change to the model itself (a re-decomposition, a retirement, a governance ruling, a corrected model), so the passing check is the whole of the evidence. Both kinds still demand a check, so this is not a way to mark something done. Never inferred when there is no file.

capability_id.description: The Capability (`cap:…`) whose delivery form is being set — `artifact` (realised by a file) or `model` (realised by the design itself).

delivery.description:
`artifact` (the default) — a file realizes it, and delivery needs both
the file and a passing check. `model` — the deliverable IS the design
change, so the check is the whole of the evidence. It says what KIND
delivers this, NEVER whether it was delivered.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

name: set_capability_delivery
title: Set Capability Delivery
